vendor: Arduino MEGA 2560 running webui/tools/motion_sensor/motion_sensor.ino (a PIR module on pin 2)
type: PIR-style motion sensor (presence level 0-1 plus a motion flag)
supply_voltage: powered from its own USB cable; only GND is shared with the probe cube
data: Streams $MOTN,L=<level 0.00-1.00>,M=<0|1>,SEQ=<n>* frames (period set by RATE). L is a smoothed presence level that rises toward ~0.85 while something moves and decays to ~0.05 when the scene is still. M is 1 while motion is detected (on above 0.5, off below 0.3). SEQ increments by 1 per frame.

test_plan.name: motion
test_plan.instruction: Wave your hand in front of the sensor for a couple of seconds.
test_plan.expect: Samples arrive. M reaches 1 at least once and L max > 0.5. seq_gaps 0.

test_plan.name: clear
test_plan.instruction: Step away and keep the area in front of the sensor still.
test_plan.expect: Samples arrive. M stays 0 and L max < 0.35 (it may start a little higher while decaying).
